settingsIaGeneralDesc: Language, input habits and how Kun behaves on your desktop.
settingsIaAppearanceDesc: Theme, text size and interface colors.
settingsIaNotificationsDesc: When Kun lets you know that work is done or needs you.
settingsIaGatewayDesc: Serve Kun's models to other Agents and coding clients on this computer.
settingsIaAssistantDesc: Which model Kun uses by default and how it talks. Accounts and API keys live under Model providers.
settingsIaPermissionsDesc: Whether an Agent asks you before it runs commands or edits files.
settingsIaSkillsDesc: Skill folders Kun loads, and which skills it may use.
settingsIaMcpDesc: External MCP tools: how they are chosen and where they are configured.
settingsIaProjectsDesc: Defaults and MCP or skill declarations for the project you are working in.
settingsIaHarnessesDesc: Bring Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode and other Agents into your conversations.
settingsIaCollaborationDesc: Defaults for team tasks where several Agents work together.
settingsIaCodeDesc: Where Code works, how it isolates branches, and the snapshots it can roll back to.
settingsIaTerminalDesc: Terminal colors, SSH servers and the kun shell command.
settingsIaPaperDesc: Paper reading, search sources and translation.
settingsIaLabsDesc: Capabilities that are still being polished. Switch one on and its settings appear.
settingsIaRuntimeDesc: The local service, context limits and runtime safeguards. Most people never need to change these.
settingsIaDiagnosticsDesc: Model request records, Agent-view capture and local error logs for troubleshooting.
settingsIaCompletionCardDesc: System notifications while Kun is in the background.
settingsIaModelCardDesc: Used by new conversations; you can switch for a single conversation from the composer.
settingsIaRuntimeLinkDesc: These advanced settings moved to System → Advanced runtime.
settingsIaFullAccessConsequence: Full access skips every confirmation, including deleting files and network commands. Switching to it asks you once more in a system prompt.
